Looping the file unchanged is fine. If the file is trimmed, crossfaded or otherwise edited before it goes into R2, the credit must say it was modified (CC BY 4.0 s3(a)(1)(B)). Don't add DRM or other technical locks to the hosted file (s2(a)(5)(B)), and don't suggest that MacLeod endorses the app. There are no region, Premium or fee limits.
